entities.name: Adeline
entities.description: A cathar of Innistrad, tactician and leader of cathars who worked with the Dawnhart Coven to reverse the Eternal night and develops a bond with Chandra.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The gothic plane where Adeline fights vampires and werewolves.

entities.name: Dawnhart Coven
entities.description: The witch coven that planned to reverse the Eternal night.

entities.name: Eternal night
entities.description: The lengthening night over Innistrad that the ritual at the Celestus was meant to reverse.

entities.name: The Travails
entities.description: The crisis during which Adeline led cathars against Emrakul.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan sealed away after the Travails.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that took Adeline in and that may have stolen the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A Dawnhart Coven witch who recruited Arlinn and the Gatewatch; her spirit later emerges from the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker and werewolf who leads the search for the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group recruited to find the Moonsilver Key.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: The key needed to restore the balance between night and day at the Celestus.

entities.name: The Celestus
entities.description: The place where the ritual to reverse the Eternal night is performed.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who delays the sunset and speeds the group's travel.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who scouts Thraben and finds a clue about the Key.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who becomes smitten with Adeline and grows close to her.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: The ruined city full of zombies that the group investigates.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: The planeswalker whose zombie army fought Emrakul.

entities.name: Worrin Betzold
entities.description: A zombie bishop of the Church of Avacyn found in Thraben.

entities.name: Dennick Betzold
entities.description: A spirit in the ruins of the Betzold mansion who tells the group where the Key is.

entities.name: Gavony
entities.description: The province where the Betzold family had a mansion.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who holds the Key and later forms a pact with the group.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: Sorin's manor where the Key is kept.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who answers the group's prayer and stops Sorin's attack.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: The alpha werewolf who attacks the Harvesttide festival and later helps at the Voldaren estate.

entities.name: Harvesttide festival
entities.description: The festival during which the ritual was attempted and Tovolar attacked.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, and later marries Edgar Markov.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: The vampire marrying Olivia at the Voldaren estate.

entities.name: Voldaren estate
entities.description: The castle where Olivia and Edgar's wedding takes place and the battle occurs.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel of Innistrad.

events.summary: Adeline is selected to lead cathars in the Travails, leaving her family; vampires abduct townsfolk including her younger brother.
events.quote: A family of vampires took advantage of the chaos and abducted several townsfolk—including Adeline's younger brother

events.summary: Once Emrakul is sealed away, Adeline begins a personal crusade against vampires.
events.quote: Adeline started a personal crusade against the vampires

events.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key, and Adeline joins them to investigate Thraben.
events.quote: Katilda of the Dawnhart Coven recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key

events.summary: The group finds Thraben destroyed and full of zombies, and Kaya scouts alone and finds a clue about the Key.
events.quote: They find the city destroyed and full of zombies

events.summary: Adeline rides at the vanguard killing zombies as the group reaches Bishop Worrin Betzold.
events.quote: Adeline on her horse went to the vanguard of the group, killing several zombies

events.summary: The spirit of Dennick Betzold tells the group the Key was given to Sorin Markov.
events.quote: they found the spirit of Dennick Betzold who tells the group the location of the Key

events.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the Key and strikes Arlinn; Sigarda appears and stops the attack, letting the group take the Key.
events.quote: Sigarda appeared, answering a prayer made by the group before entering the Manor, and stopped the attack

events.summary: Tovolar attacks the Harvesttide festival; Teferi delays the sunset and cathars led by Adeline fight the werewolves.
events.quote: Tovolar began his attack on the Harvesttide festival

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, and the Eternal Night begins.
events.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared, interrupting the ritual and taking the Key with her

events.summary: Adeline and the group help humans across Innistrad, then reluctantly return to Markov Manor and form a pact with Sorin.
events.quote: They formed a pact with Sorin

events.summary: Sorin disrupts Olivia's wedding and she drops the Key; Katilda's spirit frees Sigarda, whose holy aura breaks the manor's wards.
events.quote: Sorin managed to disrupt the ceremony and attacked Olivia who dropped the Moonsilver Key

events.summary: Adeline saves Chandra from a falling column during the battle.
events.quote: Adeline saved Chandra from a falling column

events.summary: Tovolar and his wolves arrive to help, and with the Key secured Teferi speeds the journey back to complete the ritual and restore balance.
events.quote: Tovolar and his wolves arrived to help

events.summary: After the balance is restored, Arlinn sees Adeline and Chandra embracing under a willow tree.
events.quote: Arlinn observed Adeline and Chandra together

relations.note: taken in by the church at twelve
relations.quote: Adeline was only twelve when the church took her in.

relations.note: Chandra is smitten and they grow close
relations.quote: Young Chandra quickly becomes smitten by Adeline's looks.
worked with the Dawnhart Coven to reverse the Eternal night

relations.note: fights vampires; Olivia takes the Key
relations.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared, interrupting the ritual and taking the Key with her

relations.note: joins her to find the Key
relations.quote: Adeline resisted going back there, but ended up agreeing and went with the group.
